title: Building prefix sums, then answering a range query in O(1)

steps.caption: prefix[i] = sum of the first i numbers. Start with prefix[0] = 0 (the empty prefix).
prefix[1] = prefix[0] + nums[0] = 3. Built once in O(n).
prefix[2] = prefix[1] + nums[1] = 4. Built once in O(n).
prefix[3] = prefix[2] + nums[2] = 8. Built once in O(n).
prefix[4] = prefix[3] + nums[3] = 9. Built once in O(n).
prefix[5] = prefix[4] + nums[4] = 14. Built once in O(n).
prefix[6] = prefix[5] + nums[5] = 23. Built once in O(n).
Sum of nums[2..4] = (everything up to 4) − (everything before 2) = prefix[5] − prefix[2] = 10. Any range in O(1).
